_comment: Migration numbers intentionally absent on some branches because another in-flight branch owns them. The linter treats a RESERVED number as a permitted gap (not present here, but not a numbering error). Any UNlisted gap, and any duplicate, still fails. Remove an entry once its branch merges and the number is present on main.
